script_text: Something unexpected shifts in your emotional world this week, Cancer — and it starts with tension. From Monday through Wednesday, the Moon in your 12th House forms a tense square to Venus in Aries, stirring up old feelings you thought you'd buried; this is NOT the time to start a new romance, but it IS the time to finish an old one. Wednesday brings your power moment: the Moon enters your 1st House and forms a supportive trine to Saturn in Pisces, giving you emotional clarity you've been craving since March — speak your truth in relationships now or forever hold the peace. By Thursday and Friday, Venus moves into your 5th House of pleasure and love, transforming your romantic energy entirely; if you've been single, someone from your past may reappear. The weekend brings a career opportunity: the Sun in your 10th House sextiles Jupiter in Aries on Saturday, suggesting a professional conversation could expand your ambitions. Wednesday is your power day because the Moon in your 1st House trines Saturn, grounding your emotions. Tuesday is your most challenging day due to the Moon-Saturn opposition amplifying sensitivity. Trust your gut over logic this week — your ruling planet Moon is asking you to honor what you feel before you act. Follow for daily updates.
